'''Wart''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who operated in the [[Sil'Lume asteroid belt]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{RPG}}
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the pirates that Wart was working with were encountered by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] when he was searching for a new Rebel base. The pirates mistook Skywalker for Wart, but when they realized their mistake, they attacked him.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Wart was created by [[Troy Denning]] and appeared in one of the [[Roleplaying game|role-playing]] strands of the [[1990]] [[West End Games]] role-playing supplement ''[[Jedi's Honor]]''. Due to the choose-your-own-adventure style of the scenario, Skywalker does not have to encounter Wart's pirates to progress in his mission.

==Appearances==
*''[[Jedi's Honor]]'' {{1st}}
